root.title: Tube transfer conveyor
root.description: A cleated conveyor receives soft tubes, carries them up an incline and presents them to a downstream station.

source.author: Annora
source.attribution: Original study by Annora. MK mark belongs to mk North America.
source.description: A cleated conveyor receives soft tubes, carries them up an incline and presents them to a downstream station.
source.note: Illustrative geometry and motion, informed by MK’s published tube-feeding case. Not manufacturer CAD, a specified configuration or validated performance.

groups.title: Infeed
groups.description: Crosswise tubes enter the first pockets at the low end.

groups.title: Elevation
groups.description: Follow the cleats, guides and tubes up the rising section.

groups.title: Discharge
groups.description: The upper deck presents the tubes to the next station.

groups.title: Interfaces
groups.description: The stand and mount illustrate where supports meet the process.
